The relative percentages of operating companies’ income (loss) attributable to each reportable segment and the all-other category were discussed in Note 16.  Portions of the information called for by this item are included in Operating Results by Business Segment in Item 7 of Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of this annual report on Form 10-K.

Altria Group, Inc.’s tobacco operating companies include PM USA, USSTC and other subsidiaries of UST, Middleton, Nu Mark and Nat Sherman.  Altria Group Distribution Company provides sales, distribution and consumer-engagement services to Altria Group’s tobacco operating companies.

The products of Altria’s tobacco subsidiaries include smokeable tobacco products, consisting of cigarettes manufactured and sold by PM USA and Nat Sherman, machine-made large cigars and pipe tobacco manufactured and sold by Middleton and premium cigars sold by Nat Sherman; smokeless tobacco products manufactured and sold by USSTC; and innovative tobacco products, including e-vapor products manufactured and sold by Nu Mark.

Cigarettes:  PM USA is the largest cigarette company in the United States, with total cigarette shipment volume in the United States of approximately 122.9 billion units in 2016, a decrease of 2.5 % from 2015.  Marlboro, the principal cigarette brand of PM USA, has been the largest-selling cigarette brand in the United States for over 40 years.  Nat Sherman sells substantially all of its super-premium cigarettes in the United States.

Cigars:  Middleton manufactures and sells machine-made large cigars and pipe tobacco, substantially all of which are located in the United States.  Total shipment volume for cigars was approximately 1.4 billion units in 2016, an increase of 5.9 % from 2015.  Black & Mild is the principal cigar brand of Middleton.

Smokeless tobacco products:  USSTC is the leading producer and marketer of moist smokeless tobacco products.  Substantially all of the smokeless tobacco products are manufactured and sold in the United States.  Total smokeless-product shipment volume was 853.5 million units in 2016, an increase of 4.9 % from 2015.

Innovative tobacco products:  Nu Mark participates in the e-vapor category and has developed and commercialized other innovative tobacco products.  In 2013 Nu Mark introduced MarkTen e-vapor products, and in April 2014 acquired the e-vapor business of Green Smoke.  In December 2013 Altria’s subsidiaries entered into a series of agreements with Philip Morris International (PMI) under which PMI received an exclusive licence to sell Nu Mark’s e-vapor products outside the United States, and Altria’s subsidiaries received an exclusive licence to sell two of PMI’s heated-tobacco platforms in the United States.

(Additional narrative text omitted for brevity.)

• get_yoy_percent_change(product_name, year) – signed year-over-year percentage change for the specified year (e.g. –2.5).
• get_baseline_total_volume() – returns the 100-billion baseline referenced by management when expressing segment contributions.
• compute_excess_above_baseline(volume_billion, baseline_billion) – subtract baseline to isolate excess volume.
• apply_percent_change_to_excess(excess, percent_change, reference_volume) – applies the same percentage change again to an excess amount.
• list_all_products_by_segment(segment) – lists product names in a particular reporting segment (contextual, may or may not be useful).
• get_quarterly_shipment_sum_million(product_name, year) – sum of quarterly shipment data (provided for completeness; annual data are more direct).

What would 2017 cigarette shipment volume in the United States be, in billions, if the same revenue change that occurred in 2016 happened again?
